name: Koga (Fukuoka, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Koga city emblem in orange: a stylised device of two interlocking hooked strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Koga, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 July 1971.

features.role: Koga city emblem — a stylised device of two interlocking hooked strokes
